text:
sam_support: Quick handoff — AcmeCorp trial is stuck during activation. Three customer seats hitting SSO SAML errors and bulk CSV ingest returns 500. User onboarding blocked, visible churn risk if we don't resolve in next 24h. Can CS take lead on comms and priority remediation?

provision-bot: Ticket created: INF-7890 (priority: high) — assigned to eng-integrations.

olivia_csm: Ack. I'll own outreach. Sam, can you paste the exact SAML error and one sample ingest log? Also need list of impacted org ids.

sam_support: Impacted orgs: acme-us-1, acme-eu-2, acme-intl-3. SAML error seen in console: "AssertionConsumerServiceError: invalid_response". Ingest snippet: ```ERROR 2026-11-03T14:12:03Z ingest-service: POST /v1/ingest 500 InternalServerError - body: "unexpected EOF while reading multipart form"```

matt_integrations: Looks like two separate problems — SAML assertion failing (IdP metadata mismatch?) and a multipart parsing issue on our ingest endpoint. Quick checks: confirm ACS URL registered with their IdP + check proxy/nginx client_max_body_size. For ingestion, can you retry a small file with curl to confirm reproducible? Example: ```curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -F "file=@sample.csv" https://api.redwood.example/v1/ingest```

elaine_cs_manager: Olivia, please include the standard activation-friction comms template and flag renewal-risk if they were in a paid evaluation. Who on CS will do the customer call? Also request SE on the triage call.

olivia_csm: Plan: 1) Immediate outreach email (within 30m) to primary admin and platform engineer, copy AM. 2) Offer 1-hour troubleshooting call in next 2h; include SE (matt) and support owner (sam). 3) Provide workaround for ingest (manual API path) and request IdP metadata to verify ACS. 4) If unresolved by EOD, escalate to SRE and open Dedicated quota/ingress ticket. I'll draft the email now and post copy here.

sam_support: Workaround for ingestion that I validated in sandbox (manual multipart via API): ```TOKEN=$(vault read -field=token secret/acme/trial) curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.example/v1/ingest" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -F "file=@users.csv" -F "org_id=acme-us-1"``` This succeeded with 202 on my test run. Share this with them as short-term unblock.

matt_integrations: For SAML: ask them to export IdP metadata XML and confirm ACS URL exactly equals https://app.acme.example/auth/saml/consume. If they use Okta, watch for authnContext mismatch. I'll join the call.

jira-bot: Created JIRA ticket CS-1342 (customer: AcmeCorp) linked to INF-7890, added label activation-blocker.

olivia_csm: Draft email (short): "Hey team — we're looking into the SSO + ingest failures blocking your trial. Can you confirm the IdP metadata and try the small ingest curl command attached? We're available for a troubleshooting call at 15:00 UTC. Temporary ingest workaround: manual API route. We'll update you within 2 hours and keep this prioritized." Posting to support thread after you approve, @sam_support.

sam_support: Approved. I'll forward logs and include the workaround curl.

elaine_cs_manager: Good — set an internal reminder for 6h, assign follow-up owner (olivia) and escalation owner (elaine). Capture customer sentiment in CS notes and flag renewal risk if conversion was expected this month.

olivia_csm: Done. Call scheduled, calendar invites sent to acme-admin@acme.example, acme-platform@acme.example, @matt_integrations, @sam_support. I'll own until handback or resolution. Setting a 72-hour health check after fix.

sam_support: Thanks all — ping me in-thread if you need any extra logs or temp tokens.

olivia_csm: I'll post resolution summary in this thread after the call. :white_check_mark:
